generic_meaning: A practical one-piece fabric aviation flight suit or coverall; no particular present-day institution, official uniform specification, identity or age is claimed.
concept: 비가 그친 격납고 유리 통로에서 서비스 카트의 흰 리넨 모서리를 고르는 성인 가상 모델의 일반 비행복 사진

keyword_checks.question: Does cloth visibly continue from the same wearer torso through the waist into two distinct trouser legs rather than a jacket ending over separate trousers?
keyword_checks.baseline_evidence: a generic sage-green one-piece flight suit

keyword_checks.question: Does a readable main zipped closing edge belong to the center front of that same continuous suit?
Are the selected chest and thigh utility pockets separately bounded on the suit worn by the one model?
keyword_checks.baseline_evidence: separate chest and thigh utility pockets

keyword_checks.question: Does the defined waist belt encircle that same suit at the waist without transferring its support to a separate shirt or cart?
Does the main sage-green matte woven cloth remain on the same suit torso, sleeves and legs, separately bounded from white linen and dark boots?
keyword_checks.baseline_evidence: The matte woven flight-suit fabric, crisp linen, brushed metal, and translucent wet glass have distinct surfaces

scene_checks.question: Are dark eyes, wispy parted fringe and a jaw-length dark rounded bob visibly guided by the supplied reference without asserting identity?
Do the model right thumb and index finger visibly meet the linen corner on the cart tray, with both attached to her wrist and sleeve?
Does the other hand visibly rest on the near cart rim as authored, with readable hand-to-rim contact?
Are rain traces on rear glass, cool side window light, warm wall lamp and distinct fabric/linen/metal/glass surfaces visible in the same photograph?

compiled_gate_policy: Keep the exact pack-plus-selection compiler gate set in a separate active-gates.json before any image call; these independently authored keyword checks never manufacture runtime profile authority.
